recommendations: Start with consolidate_high priority files - these provide immediate wins with low effort
Focus on primitives first (Box, Text, Image) as they form the foundation for other components
Extract shared logic from Icon components - the className parsing is complex and repeated
Consider creating a platform abstraction layer for common patterns (buttons, modals)
Maintain adapter pattern for fundamentally different implementations (motion, virtualization)
Use shared design tokens and variant systems to ensure visual consistency
